name: Al-Hijr · الحجر
en: Who have made the Qur'an into portions

name: Al-Hijr · الحجر
en: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

name: Al-Hijr · الحجر
en: About what they used to do

name: Al-Hijr · الحجر
ar: فَٱصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
en: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists

name: Al-Hijr · الحجر
en: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers

name: Al-Hijr · الحجر
ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۚ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُونَ
en: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know

name: Al-Hijr · الحجر
ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدۡرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
en: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say

name: Al-Hijr · الحجر
ar: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
en: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him]

name: Al-Hijr · الحجر
en: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death)

name: An-Nahl · النحل
ar: أَتَىٰٓ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوهُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
en: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him

name: An-Nahl · النحل
ar: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
en: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me

name: An-Nahl · النحل
ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
en: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him

name: An-Nahl · النحل
ar: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ
en: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary

name: An-Nahl · النحل
ar: وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَاۖ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا دِفۡءٞ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
en: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat

name: An-Nahl · النحل
ar: وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسۡرَحُونَ
en: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture]
